row.body: I wrote down the sour smell after the field truck unloaded its rinse barrels. The meat was still cold when the flies vanished and the siren began.
row.title: Freezer note in a butcher's hand

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace places field-program residue before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while responding; the personal trace does not by itself prove the field program caused the emergency.
